Infrared Sauna vs Red Light Therapy

An infrared sauna is a heat treatment: it warms your body until you sweat, and its evidence sits inside the wider sauna research. Red light therapy uses low levels of red or near-infrared light on the skin without meaningful heat; Cleveland Clinic says there is not enough evidence for most uses, with some promise for skin. Choose a sauna for heat and relaxation, red light for targeted skin goals.
